answer.reason: Several verses name Noph in prophecies of its coming ruin, which says more than the summary does.

clauses.english: was foretold to become waste and desolate, without an inhabitant
clauses.quote: Noph shall be waste and desolate without an inhabitant

clauses.english: was foretold to lose its idols and images
clauses.quote: I will cause their images to cease out of Noph

doubts: Noph is the Bible's name for Memphis; HOS 9:6 (the only verse using Memphis) is left out since it says only that Memphis would bury Israelites who fled.
JER 2:16 and ISA 19:13 are left out as being about Israel's injury and the princes' folly, not what happened to the city.
Both clauses rest on prophecies of judgment, not on events narrated as having happened.
